name: CommentThreaded
description: Represents a cell's threaded comment. This object can represent both a top-level comment or its replies.
remarks: The CommentThreaded object is a member of the CommentsThreaded collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Replies
properties.description: If this comment is a parent, returns a CommentsThreaded collection of CommentThreaded objects that are children/replies of the specified comment (if any exist). The replies are sorted by time stamp.

properties.name: Author
properties.description: Returns the Author object that represents the author of the specified CommentThreaded object. Read-only.

properties.name: Date
properties.description: Returns a date String-Variant that represents the date and time that a threaded comment was added in local time. Read-only.

methods.name: AddReply
methods.description: If the comment is a top-level comment, it will add a reply to its replies collection.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified threaded comment and all replies associated with that comment (if any exist).

methods.name: Text
methods.signature: Text([Text As Variant], [Start As Variant], [Overwrite As Variant]) As String

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: The character number where the added text will be placed. If the _Overwrite_ parameter is True or blank, and if this argument is omitted, any existing text in the threaded comment is deleted.

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description: False to insert the text. The default value is True (text is overwritten).

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns a CommentThreaded object that represents the next threaded comment.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Returns a CommentThreaded object that represents the previous threaded comment.
